ns2:section.sectionText: Placement in this course requires a recent, adequate score on a U of I placement exam. For dates and details see http://math.illinois.edu/ALEKS. Students not meeting the ALEKS prerequisite will be dropped during the second week of the semester. Exams in this class will take place on Thursdays: Feb 25, Mar 25 and Apr 22. Each exam is 75 minutes long, opening at 5 PM Central Time and must be completed by 11:59 PM Central Time.
